caption: The drawing shows a single ornate hair comb positioned centrally on an off-white or beige background. The comb has a large, heart-shaped top with a marbled pattern in shades of brown, red, and yellow. Inside the heart shape, there is an openwork design featuring symmetrical scrolls and floral motifs. The comb section extends downward from the heart shape, with five equally spaced, tapering prongs also displaying the marbled coloration. In the lower left corner of the image, there is a small, simple, monochrome sketch of a similarly shaped comb viewed from the side, and in the lower right corner, the name "E. Schwabe" is written.
title: Tortoise Shell Comb
